sentences.en: We need to preserve democracy even with depleted uranium bombs.
sentences.zh: 我们需要即使在使用贫化铀炸弹的情况下也要保护民主。

sentences.en: I would not do that because it depletes the battery.
sentences.zh: 我不会那样做，因为这会耗尽电池。

sentences.en: Depleted uranium bombs are US democracy's most effective weapon.
sentences.zh: 贫化铀炸弹是美国民主最有效的武器。
